_comment: AD-9 model seeding: agent-slug -> default Claude model id. Consumed once at member-creation time by AgentsTemplateService.DefaultModels() (see GigaClaw.Core/Services/AgentsTemplateService.cs). Editing this file after a project already has members has no effect on those members — change the member's DefaultModel directly (PATCH /api/projects/{slug}/members/{memberId}) instead. Model ids must match GigaClaw.Core/Models/ClaudeModelCatalog.cs. Tier criteria: haiku = mechanical/high-volume/low-ambiguity (git ops, formatting, doc updates); sonnet = drafting/coding/analysis/research (bulk output, unit tests, copy); opus = judgment/gates/auditing/watchdog (governance, security, reviews, final approvals). Per wshobson caveat, security and reviewer agents must not use sub-Opus tiers.
